newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian bonds close flat as traders await data.
newsitem.headline: Canadian bonds close flat as traders await data.

text.p: Canadian bonds closed little changed in quiet trade on Monday, with most traders looking ahead to Canadian and U.S. economic reports out later in the week, analysts said.

"It's a pretty a busy data week in the U.S. and Canada. I think it's steady as we go until we get into tomorrow's numbers," said Craig Wright, deputy chief economist with Royal Bank of Canada. "Everybody's trying to get an idea what the Fed's going to do next."
Canada's 30-year benchmark bond traded unchanged at C$110.80 to yield 7.085 percent.
The U.S. 30-year bond rose 1/32 to yield 6.89 percent. The spread between the two bonds was 20 basis points, unchanged from Friday's close.
"It's been very, very quiet day. There were very little flows," said a bond dealer with one bank-owned brokerage.

Both Canadian and U.S. bonds traded in a narrow range on Monday with no significant economic reports released in either country. However, analysts said bond market activity is likely to pick up significantly with the release of several key pieces of data, beginning with the U.S. retail sales report for April out on Tuesday.
Other significant economic data out this week includes the Canadian and U.S. consumer price index reports for April, out on Thursday.

Analysts said investors will be scouring those and other reports for clues about the timing of the next likely move in U.S. interest rates. The U.S. Federal Reserve's rate setting Open Market Committee meets on May 20 and opinion is divided on whether they will choose to raise rates for a second time this year.
In other prices, Canada's 10-year benchmark bond rose C$0.02 to C$103.17 to yield 6.547 percent. The U.S. bond rose 1/32 to yield 6.66 percent.
The negative spread between the two bonds narrowed to 11 basis points from 13 basis points at the close of trading on Friday.
The three-month cash T-bill traded with a yield of 3.04 percent against its U.S. equivalent which yielded 5.16 percent.
